title: Amos Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Amos 5: the lamentation over Israel, the call to seek Yahweh and justice rolling on like rivers.

questions.text: What does the lamentation over the house of Israel say about the virgin of Israel?
questions.explanation: In the lamentation over the house of Israel, the virgin of Israel has fallen and shall rise no more; she is cast down on her land with no one to raise her up.

answers.text: She has fallen and will rise no more
She will be restored in a day
She has gone up to Bethel

questions.text: How many will be left of the city that went out a thousand?
questions.explanation: The city that went out a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went out one hundred shall have ten left.

questions.text: Which three places does God tell them not to seek, enter or pass to?
questions.explanation: They are told not to seek Bethel, not to enter into Gilgal and not to pass to Beersheba.

questions.text: In whose house does verse 6 warn he may break out like fire?
questions.explanation: They are told to seek Yahweh and live, lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph and devour it.

questions.text: What do they turn justice into, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 speaks of those who turn justice to wormwood and cast down righteousness to the earth.

questions.text: Which constellations does verse 8 say he made?
questions.explanation: They are told to seek him who made the Pleiades and Orion and turns the shadow of death into the morning.

questions.text: What does verse 11 say about the houses of cut stone they built?
questions.explanation: Because they trample on the poor, they have built houses of cut stone but will not dwell in them.

answers.text: They will be filled with grain
They will be burned with fire
They will not dwell in them

questions.text: What does verse 15 tell them to establish?
questions.explanation: They are told to hate evil, love good and establish justice in the courts.

questions.text: What does God say about their songs in verse 23?
questions.explanation: He tells them to take away from him the noise of their songs, for he will not listen to the music of their harps.

answers.text: He will not listen to them

questions.text: Where does God say he will cause them to go into captivity?
questions.explanation: He says he will cause them to go into captivity beyond Damascus.
